notes: Nested audit results, parent task block hashes, child mappings, and source task hashes are recorded from Astra’s independent read-only printer audit. This agent did not rerun the nested -a printer; the exact task formula/coma hashes are linked per target above.

task_printer.nested_split_printing: The independent audit printed nested tasks with -a split_vc; no solver was selected. Parent blocks were isolated by exact own-goal key, and block SHA-256 was computed after removing the leading theory line. Context comparison used the block prefix before the final goal, with only axiom labels normalized.
